newsitem.title: ROMANIA: BUCHAREST STOCK EXCHANGE DOWN IN BEARISH PHASE.
newsitem.headline: BUCHAREST STOCK EXCHANGE DOWN IN BEARISH PHASE.

text.p: Most Bucharest bourse stocks saw their average prices drift to fresh lows on Wednesday in a bearish mood extended from previous sessions this week.
Two unofficial indices, the VAB and the BIG, fell by 6.2 and respectively 5.67 percent from the previous session. BIG first-tier index was 7.38 percent down to 2,586.6 points.
"With bears prominent in the market today trading was lazy and volumes and turnover went down," said a trader.
Volumes dropped to 1.8 million shares from 1.9 million on Tuesday, as 12 companies failed to arouse any investor interest and ended the day with no deal.
Turnover was 680 million lei down at 4.8 billion.
Nineteen stocks lost on their average prices, five climbed and two were suspended. Deals struck in late trading helped some of the stocks close higher.
The first tier accounted for around 79 percent of turnover, but all four listings posted lower average prices and two of them also closed lower.
Azomures fertiliser maker and pharmaceuticals company Terapia shed 250 and respectively 750 lei to close at 2,100 and 5,500.

Traders said the lower average and closing quotes of Azomures were a result of the bearish attitude on the market rather than of an announcement on Wednesday from its main stockholder the State Ownership Fund (FPS).
The FPS said it had cancelled a contract to sell 51 percent of Azomures to a local trading company after its failure to meet the payment deadline.
Oltchim chemical plant closed 150 lei stronger at 2,400 and pharmaceuticals Antibiotice stayed flat at 4,100 lei.
Policolor dye maker was the only stock to put on a stronger performance on the second tier. It had 842 million lei in turnover, but it closed 100 lei weaker at 5,100.
